label.description: Visible label, also the accessible name of the trigger and the list.

hideLabel.description: Keeps the label for assistive technology only.

items.description: Options { value, label, icon?, meta?, keywords?, disabled? } or groups { label, options }, in display order.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new value and its option.

searchable.description: Shows a search field in place of the trigger when open. auto turns it on above eight options.

searchPlaceholder.description: Search field placeholder. Defaults to the selected label, then "Search".

panelWidth.description: Width of the open surface in px. Never narrower than the trigger.

maxListHeight.description: Tallest the option list gets before it scrolls, in px.

align.description: Which edge of the trigger stays put while the surface grows.

name.description: Adds a hidden input for native form submission.
